extra_quotes: Here, we combineab initio and reactive molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of depleted MoS2, MoSe2, and Janus MoSSe, examining each remaining chalcogen on two parent lattices, to show that the remaining chalcogen type determines the structural reconstruction, with only a minor influence from the parent lattice.
